attributes.context: The preceding sentence requires straight time wages, overtime wages, and other premium pay to be itemized on each paycheck, with deductions also noted.

extraction_text: If the Company revises its payroll computer system, it is understood and agreed that such computer revision will reflect separately itemized on the paycheck voucher the following items: straight time wages, time and one-half (1½), double time (2x) wages, other premiums or differentials, and deductions possible within the capabilities of the system.

attributes.context: The current chunk further describes that tool and equipment needs identified by advisory boards are reviewed by the Company and Union at the June Labor/Management meeting for inclusion in the upcoming year's budget, that seasonal work units submit requests at the end of their season, and that units without functioning advisory boards may submit their needs to the Labor/Management Committee.

extraction_text: The Company will present their plans for the purchase of different tools and/or equipment to the advisory boards prior to their purchase to seek input and ensure usefulness.
